COLONY.io is a platform for creating decentralized autonomous organizations on the Ethereum public blockchain. COLONY.io runs its organizational logic through smart contracts rather than a central intermediary. COLONY.io uses an on-chain reputation system to reflect member contributions.

Mantra DAO is a project focused on tokenizing real-world assets. Mantra DAO uses the OM token within its ecosystem.

Lido is a liquid staking protocol built on smart contracts on public blockchains. Lido issues stETH tokens that represent ether staked through the protocol. Lido is governed by holders of its LDO token.
